title: Correct voltage calculation
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the secondary voltage (u2) must be 55 V.

title: Correct current calculation
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the secondary current (I2) must be 8 A.

title: Applies voltage ratio
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the transformer voltage ratio u2/u1 = n2/n1.

title: Applies current ratio
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the transformer current ratio I2/I1 = n1/n2.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answers should be presented with correct units (V and A).

title: Inverts ratio for voltage
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student inverts the turns ratio (n1/n2) when calculating voltage.

title: Inverts ratio for current
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student inverts the turns ratio (n2/n1) when calculating current.
